name: podium
description: A live fleet console for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and OpenCode: every session, agent, plan, cost and context window in one browser tab.
author: Ed Engelking

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w server && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w frontend
